================================================================================
  Octeka.Cartographer - Multi-Language REST & Fluent API Client Generator
  Copyright (c) 2026 Patrick Robichaud (operating as OCTEKA)
================================================================================

Usage: cartographer -s <spec-path-or-url> -o <output-directory> [options]

Options:
  -s, --spec <path/url>    Path or URL to OpenAPI/Swagger/TypeSpec spec    [Required]
  -o, --output <dir>       Target output directory for the client library  [Required]
  -l, --language <lang>    Target language: 'csharp' (default), 'python', 'rust', 'cpp', 'c', 'typescript', 'ruby', 'go'
  -p, --project <name>     Project / library file name (e.g. 'Octeka.Api.Jira')
  -n, --namespace <ns>     Root namespace / package name (default: inferred or matching -p)
  -c, --name <name>        Primary API client class name (default: inferred)
  -d, --driver <driver>    HTTP driver ('octeka-rest', 'restsharp', 'httpclient', 'httpx', 'reqwest', 'cpr', 'libcurl', 'fetch', 'faraday', 'standard')
  -w, --writer <style>     Writer style: 'fluent' (default) or 'flat'
  -k, --clean <bool>       Clean Generated/ folder before generating (default: true)
  -u, --base-url <url>     Override base URL for the API endpoints
  -v, --verbose            Enable diagnostic verbose logging
  -h, --help               Display this help and usage screen
